🆕 NEW RELEASE: New Junk City release fourth album Where Could I Go?

The Atlanta band's fourth full-length is a melodic punk record about love, grief, responsibility and the compromises of building a life with someone. It was recorded at Standard Electric with producer Tyler Bisson.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: The Interrupters announce a huge European run for 2027

The ska-punk favorites will play 24 shows across Europe and the UK in May and June 2027. Germany gets a headline show in Munich plus festival slots at Southside, Hurricane and Vainstream.
